title: Learning to Better Search with Language Models via Guided Reinforced Self-Training
authors_zh: Seungyong Moon, Bumsoo Park, Hyun Oh Song
paper_type_zh: 特权引导的搜索轨迹构造与自训练方法
best_for_zh: 适合研究搜索轨迹蒸馏、迭代自训练、代码修复反馈和特权信息泄漏审计的读者
one_line: Guided-ReST uses optimal solutions as training-time landmarks to repair, verify, and distill current-policy search traces.
Guided-ReST 用最优解作为仅构造期可见的局部地标，修补并筛选策略自身的搜索轨迹；其价值在于展示特权引导蒸馏配方，但未发布冻结轨迹语料。
why: It makes the privileged construction view, the filtered or masked training view, and the unassisted inference view explicit, which is central to auditing search-generated reasoning data.
inclusion_reason: Provides a concrete, inspectable recipe for converting privileged optimal artifacts and failed policy search into filtered SFT trajectories for arithmetic reasoning and code self-repair.

title: Problem
问题
html:
Guided-ReST addresses a data-construction problem: how can a model learn useful search behavior from its own failed and successful attempts when ordinary outcome-filtered self-training rarely gives a weak policy enough positive trajectories? Stream of Search (SoS) first trains a model on linearized symbolic traces containing generation, exploration, verification, and backtracking. Those traces improve search generalization over behavior cloning an optimal path, but they can spend a fixed token budget on irrelevant branches. ReST retains successful self-generated traces, yet supplies no localized correction when the current policy fails.

The official record is the NeurIPS 2025 Main Conference paper, with arXiv v2 and OpenReview records and an official implementation. The work belongs in Data Construction and Open Release Recipes because its central contribution is a transformation from answer-keyed tasks, current-policy behavior, and privileged optimal artifacts into verified SFT trajectories. It is not a new benchmark, a human preference dataset, a learned reward model, or a frozen corpus release.

The paper studies two record types. A Countdown record starts from four integers and a target and contains a language-form tree-search trace over legal arithmetic states and operations. A code self-repair record is a multi-turn message sequence: a complete reasoning-and-code attempt, execution feedback, a revision instruction, and another attempt. In both settings the current policy authors the generated behavior; an optimal Countdown path or reference program is available only to the construction process; and a programmatic checker determines whether a candidate can be retained.

Three data views must remain separate. The privileged construction view contains optimal subgoals or reference code. The training view contains an edited Countdown trace or a code episode in which the real reference program is replaced by the documented dummy marker. The inference view receives neither optimal artifact. This Card reaches the accepted L4 boundary because the paper, supplement, venue metadata, affiliations, code, license, sampling settings, filtering scripts, and workflow state were checked; generated buffers, checkpoints, and a frozen data release remain unavailable.

Guided-ReST 处理的是一个具体的数据构造问题：普通结果筛选式自训练很难让较弱策略产生足够多的成功轨迹，如何利用策略自身的失败与成功尝试来学习更有效的搜索行为？Stream of Search（SoS）先让模型学习由 generation、exploration、verification 和 backtracking 组成的线性化符号搜索轨迹；这类轨迹比只模仿最优路径更有利于搜索泛化，但可能把固定 token 预算浪费在无关分支上。ReST 只保留成功的自生成轨迹，却不会在当前策略失败时提供局部纠正。

官方来源是 NeurIPS 2025 Main Conference 论文，并有 arXiv v2、OpenReview 记录和官方实现。该工作属于 Data Construction and Open Release Recipes，因为其核心贡献是把带答案的任务、当前策略行为和特权最优产物转换为通过验证的 SFT 轨迹。它不是新 benchmark、人工偏好数据集、学习式奖励模型，也没有发布冻结语料。

论文研究两类记录。Countdown 记录以四个整数和目标数为输入，包含由合法算术状态与运算构成的语言化树搜索轨迹；代码自修复记录是多轮消息序列，依次包含完整推理与代码尝试、执行反馈、修改指令和下一次尝试。两种场景都由当前策略生成行为；最优 Countdown 路径或参考程序只对构造流程可见；候选是否能保留由程序化检查器决定。

必须区分三种数据视图。特权构造视图含最优子目标或参考代码；训练视图含被改写的 Countdown 轨迹，或把真实参考程序替换为论文所述 dummy marker 的代码 episode；推理视图看不到任何最优产物。当前 Card 达到已接受的 L4 边界，是因为论文、补充材料、会议元数据、机构、代码、许可证、采样设置、筛选脚本和 workflow state 均已核验；生成 buffer、checkpoint 与冻结数据发布仍不可用。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
Guided-ReST uses an optimal solution as a sequence of local landmarks for repairing the policy's own search, rather than as a complete response to imitate. The intended data operation preserves failed exploration as context, replaces one failed continuation with the next optimal subgoal, truncates the now-inconsistent suffix, and lets the same policy search onward. Preliminary Countdown evidence explains the design: as an optimal prefix grows from zero to three steps, success rises from 55.96% to 100%, but cross-entropy loss also rises from 0.0481 to 0.2539, suggesting that wholesale prefix distillation moves away from the policy distribution (Paper Table 1).

For Countdown, each node on the optimal path is a subgoal. If a trace reaches subgoal t-1 but fails below it, the algorithm randomly selects an explored child, replaces that child's operation and resulting state with subgoal t, discards the inconsistent suffix, and samples a continuation. It repeats this process until the trace succeeds or all subgoals have been inserted. The resulting record contains policy exploration before the correction, explicit privileged structure at the correction, and a policy-generated suffix.

For code self-repair, a full turn is the search unit because a fine-grained code tree is impractical. A candidate program is executed; selected public-test failures become the next feedback message. During an augmentation round, the feedback also contains a ground-truth reference program and the policy regenerates the remaining turns. For the saved training view, the real program is replaced by the literal dummy marker # REFERENCE CODE HERE, while the paper reports loss only on the final model response. Thus the guide affects which continuation is generated without remaining verbatim in the SFT input.

The feedback contract is answer-level and programmatic, not process truth. Countdown checks whether the full trace legally reaches the target. In code, public-test results drive interaction, but the official implementation computes a binary score from all ground-truth tests attached to the task and retains only rows with positive score. These checks observe executable outcome and arithmetic legality; they do not judge explanation faithfulness, minimality, robustness, or whether a candidate exploits weak tests.

Compared with behavior cloning, SoS, ReST, sparse-reward PPO, and the single-round stronger-guide interaction discussed in related work, the distinguishing change is repeated, localized use of privileged information during data generation. The contribution is therefore a construction and masking contract, not the isolated invention of self-training, tree search, PPO, or execution feedback.

Guided-ReST 不把最优解当作整段模仿答案，而是将其拆成一系列局部地标，用来修补策略自己的搜索。该数据操作保留失败探索作为上下文，把一条失败延续替换成下一个最优子目标，删除因此失效的后缀，再让同一个策略继续搜索。Countdown 预实验说明了这一设计：最优前缀从零步增加到三步时，成功率由 55.96% 上升到 100%，但交叉熵损失也从 0.0481 增至 0.2539，说明整段前缀蒸馏会逐渐偏离当前策略分布（论文 Table 1）。

在 Countdown 中，最优路径上的每个节点都是一个子目标。如果轨迹已到达子目标 t-1，却在其下方搜索失败，算法会随机选取一个已探索子节点，用子目标 t 替换该节点的运算和结果状态，删除不再一致的后缀，再采样续写。这个过程持续到轨迹成功或所有子目标都被插入。最终记录同时包含纠正前的策略探索、纠正点处的显式特权结构，以及纠正后的策略生成后缀。

在代码自修复中，细粒度代码树不实用，因此一整轮交互就是搜索单位。候选程序被执行，选出的公开测试失败会成为下一条反馈消息；进入增强轮次时，反馈还会加入 ground-truth reference program，随后由策略重新生成剩余轮次。保存训练视图时，真实程序被字面 dummy marker # REFERENCE CODE HERE 替换；论文同时说明只对最后一次模型回复计算损失。因此，引导改变了被生成的续写，但不会以真实参考程序原文留在 SFT 输入中。

反馈契约是答案级、程序化判断，而不是过程真值。Countdown 检查整条轨迹是否通过合法运算到达目标数。代码场景用公开测试结果推动交互，但官方实现会根据任务附带的全部 ground-truth tests 计算二元分数，并只保留正分记录。这些检查能够观察可执行结果和算术合法性，却不能判断解释是否忠实、程序是否最简或稳健，也不能排除候选利用弱测试的可能。

与 behavior cloning、SoS、ReST、稀疏奖励 PPO，以及 related work 中讨论的单轮强 guide 交互相比，真正不同之处是构造数据时反复、局部地使用特权信息。因此，这项贡献是一份构造与遮蔽契约，而不是单独发明 self-training、树搜索、PPO 或 execution feedback。

title: Method
方法
html:
1. Initialize task-specific policies. Countdown starts from Llama-3.2-1B-Instruct and an SoS initialization trained for two epochs on 500,000 traces generated by heuristic-guided DFS and bounded BFS. Code self-repair starts from Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct and 16,000 SYNTHETIC-1 problems drawn from APPS, CodeContests, and TACO that have at least one reference solution.

2. Generate current-policy behavior. Each Countdown iteration samples one trace for each of 200,000 problems at temperature 1.0, top-p 1.0, and a 4,096-token response cap. Each code iteration samples eight episodes per problem, at most four turns, temperature 1.0, top-p 1.0, and a 16,384-token response cap. A code turn contains a full reasoning-and-program response; the next user message contains selected public-test results and a repair instruction.

3. Add privileged guidance only after failure. Countdown parses the optimal path into subgoal nodes. At successive failure points it edits one explored child into the next correct operation and arithmetic state, truncates the invalidated suffix, and continues sampling. Code repair truncates a failed episode at a selected turn, appends the reference program to the next feedback message, and regenerates the suffix. Later augmentation rounds move the guided turn deeper into the episode.

4. Produce the trainable view. Countdown retains the successful edited trace. Code generation uses the real reference program, but the saved response history substitutes # REFERENCE CODE HERE in the guided message. The paper states that SFT loss is computed only on the last model response. This is a lossy transformation: the training row no longer contains the true reference program, so reproducing or auditing the construction requires the pre-mask generation view and its provenance.

5. Verify, filter, and train. Countdown's grade_search_path checker returns 1 only for a legal trace reaching the target; otherwise it returns 0. In code generation, public tests control whether another repair turn is needed, while the repository's reward function executes the candidate against all task ground-truth tests. Both main_data.py scripts keep only rows with score > 0.0, map each retained prompt plus response history to a messages record, and discard the other generation columns from the SFT file. SFT uses AdamW, batch size 256, learning rate 1e-5, cosine scheduling, weight decay 0.01, maximum gradient norm 1.0, and two epochs. Generation plus SFT is repeated three times.

6. Optionally optimize Countdown with PPO. One action is a complete textual tree operation and the state is the question plus preceding operations. The paper uses Monte Carlo returns, removes the KL penalty, and reports two epochs, 1,024 rollouts, temperature 1.0, PPO clip 0.2, batch size 256, discount factor 1.0, actor learning rate 1e-6, and critic learning rate 1e-5. The terminal reward remains binary. Code self-repair does not receive PPO because of compute limits.

7. Evaluate under stated boundaries. Countdown uses 10,000 seen-target and 10,000 unseen-target examples while varying the response-token budget up to 4,096. Code evaluation uses 165 CodeContests problems, acknowledged as near-distribution, and 408 more recent CodeForces problems, described as out-of-distribution; extracted programs are run on private tests.

8. Freeze what the official release does and does not provide. Repository commit 05d0c89b53f5a605b3140aecbbca853128f46f57 provides download, generation, filtering, SFT, PPO, and evaluation code under Apache-2.0. It reports a four-A100 training setup and one RTX 3090 for inference. No tag, GitHub release, trained checkpoint, frozen Guided-ReST rollout buffer, record manifest, or consolidated upstream-data license was verified. Reproduction must therefore pin the commit, author-hosted input dataset revisions, environment and execution sandbox, masks, splits, and generated record IDs.

1. 初始化任务专用策略。 Countdown 以 Llama-3.2-1B-Instruct 为基础，先在 500,000 条由启发式 DFS 和有界 BFS 生成的轨迹上进行两轮 SoS 初始化训练。代码自修复以 Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct 为基础，并使用从 APPS、CodeContests 和 TACO 汇集到 SYNTHETIC-1、且至少含一个参考解的 16,000 道题。

2. 生成当前策略行为。 Countdown 每轮对 200,000 道题各采样一条轨迹，temperature 1.0、top-p 1.0、回复上限 4,096 token。代码每轮对每道题采样八个 episode，每个最多四轮，temperature 1.0、top-p 1.0、回复上限 16,384 token。代码的一轮包含完整推理与程序回复，下一条用户消息包含选出的公开测试结果和修复指令。

3. 只在失败后加入特权引导。 Countdown 把最优路径解析为子目标节点；在连续失败点处，把一个已探索子节点改成下一个正确运算与算术状态，删除失效后缀，再继续采样。代码修复在指定轮次截断失败 episode，把参考程序加入下一条反馈消息，再重新生成后缀；后续增强轮次会把被引导的位置逐渐后移。

4. 生成可训练视图。 Countdown 保留成功的改写轨迹。代码生成阶段使用真实参考程序，但保存的回复历史会在引导消息中替换为 # REFERENCE CODE HERE。论文说明 SFT 损失只作用于最后一次模型回复。这是有损变换：训练记录不再包含真实参考程序，因此复现和审计构造过程仍需保留遮蔽前生成视图及其 provenance。

5. 验证、筛选并训练。 Countdown 的 grade_search_path 只有在合法轨迹到达目标数时返回 1，否则返回 0。代码生成阶段由公开测试决定是否继续修复，但仓库 reward function 会让候选程序执行任务附带的全部 ground-truth tests。两个 main_data.py 都只保留 score > 0.0 的记录，把 prompt 与回复历史映射成一条 messages 记录，并从 SFT 文件中删除其他生成字段。SFT 使用 AdamW、batch size 256、学习率 1e-5、cosine scheduler、weight decay 0.01、最大梯度范数 1.0，训练两个 epoch；“生成—SFT”共重复三轮。

6. 可选地对 Countdown 做 PPO。 一个动作是一整条文本化树操作，状态由问题和此前操作组成。论文使用 Monte Carlo return、移除 KL penalty，并报告两个训练 epoch、1,024 个 rollout、temperature 1.0、PPO clip 0.2、batch size 256、discount factor 1.0、actor 学习率 1e-6 和 critic 学习率 1e-5。终局奖励仍是二元信号。代码自修复因算力限制没有进行 PPO。

7. 在明确边界下评测。 Countdown 使用 10,000 条已见目标和 10,000 条未见目标样本，并把回复 token 预算最高增加到 4,096。代码评测含 165 道 CodeContests 题，论文承认其为近分布；另有 408 道更新的 CodeForces 题，被描述为分布外；抽取出的程序在私有测试上执行。

8. 固定官方发布的提供与缺失。 仓库 commit 05d0c89b53f5a605b3140aecbbca853128f46f57 以 Apache-2.0 提供下载、生成、筛选、SFT、PPO 和评测代码；论文报告训练使用四张 A100，推理使用一张 RTX 3090。未核验到 tag、GitHub release、训练 checkpoint、冻结 Guided-ReST rollout buffer、record manifest 或统一的上游数据许可证。复现时必须固定 commit、作者托管的输入数据版本、环境与执行沙箱、mask、split 和生成记录 ID。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
The strongest evidence concerns method behavior under fixed task and model settings; it is not an audit of every generated record.

Why localized guidance is used. In the 10,000-example Countdown motivation study, supplying zero, one, two, or three optimal-prefix steps raises search success from 55.96% to 85.28%, 95.27%, and 100.00%. Cross-entropy loss simultaneously rises from 0.0481 to 0.1245, 0.2412, and 0.2539. The authors use this trade-off to motivate local editing rather than direct imitation of a long optimal prefix (Paper Table 1).

Countdown accuracy and candidate coverage. With Llama-3.2-1B-Instruct, 500,000 SoS initialization traces, three 200,000-problem Guided-ReST iterations, and optional operation-level PPO, the full system reaches about 87% greedy accuracy at the 4,096-token maximum budget on both seen and unseen targets. The paper reports a margin of more than ten percentage points over the second-best PPO baseline and comparable accuracy using about half as many tokens (Paper §5.2, Figure 3). Before final PPO, Guided-ReST versus ReST pass@1/pass@32 is 62.7/96.8 versus 62.3/76.6 on seen targets, and 61.0/96.8 versus 60.8/77.0 on unseen targets at temperature 1.0 (Paper Table 2). The larger pass@k gap supports the narrower claim that the data-generation procedure broadens correct-candidate coverage under this setup.

Optimizer and reward ablations. At the maximum Countdown budget, operation-level PPO reaches 87%, compared with 83% for token-level PPO. The paper reports approximately 2 times higher token efficiency in the low-budget regime and 1.5 times in the high-budget regime (Paper §5.4, Figure 5). A dense reward that adds 0.25 when an optimal subgoal is reached has little effect overall and slightly hurts high-budget performance; reward is granted only once per subgoal to limit repeated-subgoal hacking (Paper §5.5, Figure 6). This negative result distinguishes construction-time privileged guidance from reward shaping.

Code self-repair. With Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct, 16,000 training problems, eight episodes per problem, four turns, and three SFT iterations, Guided-ReST achieves pass@1/pass@32 of 10.5/33.9 on 165 CodeContests tasks, versus ReST at 9.4/30.4. On 408 CodeForces tasks, the corresponding values are 9.7/37.6 and 9.7/35.9 (Paper Table 3). The authors describe these improvements as moderate and attribute the smaller effect to fewer training problems, incomplete episode-level augmentation, and weaker search. CodeContests is explicitly near-distribution because the training mixture includes that source; CodeForces is the more informative out-of-distribution check.

Release evidence. The official repository supplies runnable stages and source-level checks for masking, arithmetic verification, code execution, positive-score filtering, SFT, PPO, and evaluation. The checked commit has no tag or release and provides neither generated Guided-ReST buffers nor trained checkpoints. The reported benchmark gains therefore support the algorithm under the paper's conditions, not the quality, licensing, decontamination, diversity, or safe reusability of an unavailable frozen corpus. Results were not independently reproduced for this Card, and the main paper reports no error bars.

最强证据说明的是方法在固定任务与模型设置下的行为，而不是对每条生成记录的数据审计。

为什么使用局部引导。 在 10,000 条 Countdown 样本的动机实验中，最优前缀从零步增加到一、二、三步时，搜索成功率由 55.96% 依次升至 85.28%、95.27% 和 100.00%；交叉熵损失也从 0.0481 升至 0.1245、0.2412 和 0.2539。作者用这一权衡支持局部改写，而不是直接模仿长最优前缀（论文 Table 1）。

Countdown 准确率与候选覆盖。 在 Llama-3.2-1B-Instruct、500,000 条 SoS 初始化轨迹、三轮各 200,000 道题的 Guided-ReST，以及可选 operation-level PPO 设置下，完整系统在 4,096-token 最大预算下对已见和未见目标都达到约 87% greedy accuracy。论文报告其比次优 PPO 高十个百分点以上，并用约一半 token 达到相近准确率（论文 §5.2、Figure 3）。在最终 PPO 之前，temperature 1.0 下，Guided-ReST 与 ReST 在已见目标上的 pass@1/pass@32 分别为 62.7/96.8 与 62.3/76.6，在未见目标上分别为 61.0/96.8 与 60.8/77.0（论文 Table 2）。随 k 增大的差距支持一个更窄的结论：在该设置下，这种数据生成流程扩大了正确候选覆盖。

优化器与奖励消融。 在 Countdown 最大预算下，operation-level PPO 达到 87%，token-level PPO 为 83%；论文报告前者在低预算区约有 2 倍 token 效率，在高预算区约有 1.5 倍（论文 §5.4、Figure 5）。另一种稠密奖励在到达最优子目标时增加 0.25，为减少重复子目标的 reward hacking，每个子目标只计奖一次；该方案整体收益很小，并在高预算下略有下降（论文 §5.5、Figure 6）。这个负结果说明构造期特权引导不等价于 reward shaping。

代码自修复。 在 Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct、16,000 道训练题、每题八个 episode、最多四轮和三次 SFT 迭代下，Guided-ReST 在 165 道 CodeContests 题上的 pass@1/pass@32 为 10.5/33.9，ReST 为 9.4/30.4；在 408 道 CodeForces 题上，两者分别为 9.7/37.6 和 9.7/35.9（论文 Table 3）。作者把增益描述为中等，并将较小效果归因于训练题更少、episode-level augmentation 不完整和搜索能力较弱。CodeContests 因训练混合中含同源题而被明确视为近分布，CodeForces 才是更有信息量的分布外检查。

发布证据。 官方仓库提供可运行阶段与源码级检查，覆盖遮蔽、算术验证、代码执行、正分筛选、SFT、PPO 和评测。核验 commit 没有 tag 或 release，也没有提供生成的 Guided-ReST buffer 或训练 checkpoint。因此，基准增益只支持论文条件下的算法表现，不能证明一个尚未冻结发布的语料在质量、许可、去污染、多样性或安全复用方面合格。本 Card 未独立复现实验，主论文也未报告 error bar。

title: Novelty
新意
html:
The paper's data-level novelty is where privileged information enters the pipeline and how it is removed or transformed before deployment.

  • Behavior cloning imitates an optimal path directly; SoS imitates symbolic search traces; ReST filters successful policy samples; sparse-reward PPO updates the policy from terminal outcomes. Guided-ReST instead uses the optimal path to choose and edit a recovery point inside a failed self-search, then distills the completed trace.
  • Countdown defines an explicit node-level transformation: replace one explored child operation and resulting state with the next optimal subgoal, truncate the inconsistent suffix, and resample. The retained trace contains both failed policy context and a localized oracle intervention.
  • Code repair introduces an episode-level analogue when subgoals are difficult to define. The reference program guides generation inside feedback, but the trainable view substitutes a dummy marker and applies loss only to the final response. The privileged field therefore changes the sampled target without remaining as the real program in the learner input.
  • Guidance is applied at successive failure points rather than as a single demonstration or one-round strong-teacher continuation. This repeated guide-policy interaction is the main difference the authors draw from the closest guide-model data-generation work.
  • Guided-ReST SFT and operation-level PPO are separate components. Action grouping and the dense-reward negative result matter for downstream optimization, but they do not change the provenance or masking contract of the SFT records.

What is not new in isolation includes self-training, outcome filtering, tree-search traces, execution feedback, PPO, and teacher-student distillation. The direction signal for reasoning-data research is the three-view contract: a privileged construction view, an edited or masked training view, and an unassisted inference view. Reuse requires preserving the transformation and intervention provenance, not collapsing both tasks into a generic teacher-generated label.

论文在数据层面的新意，是特权信息在流水线的哪个位置进入，以及部署前如何被移除或转换。

  • Behavior cloning 直接模仿最优路径；SoS 模仿符号搜索轨迹；ReST 过滤策略的成功样本；稀疏奖励 PPO 根据终局结果更新策略。Guided-ReST 则用最优路径在失败自搜索中选择并改写一个恢复点，再蒸馏完成后的轨迹。
  • Countdown 定义了明确的节点级变换：用下一个最优子目标替换一个已探索子节点的运算与结果状态，删除不一致后缀，再重新采样。保留轨迹同时含失败策略上下文和局部 oracle 介入。
  • 当代码任务难以定义细粒度子目标时，代码自修复给出 episode-level 对应形式。参考程序通过反馈引导生成，但可训练视图会把它替换为 dummy marker，并只对最后一次回复计算损失。因此，特权字段改变了采样目标，却不会以真实程序形式留在学习器输入中。
  • 引导会在连续失败点反复使用，而不是只提供一段 demonstration 或一次强教师续写。这种重复的 guide-policy 交互，是作者相对最接近 guide-model 数据生成工作的主要区别。
  • Guided-ReST SFT 与 operation-level PPO 是两个独立组件。动作分组和稠密奖励负结果对后续优化有意义，但不会改变 SFT 记录的来源或遮蔽契约。

单独看，self-training、结果筛选、树搜索轨迹、execution feedback、PPO 和 teacher-student distillation 都不是本文新创。对 reasoning data 研究真正有方向意义的是三视图契约：特权构造视图、改写或遮蔽后的训练视图、无辅助推理视图。复用时必须保留变换与介入 provenance，而不能把两个任务都压缩成泛化的 teacher-generated 标签。

title: Limitations
局限
html:
Access to privileged solutions is the core assumption. Guided-ReST requires an optimal Countdown path or a reference program. Countdown also assumes an oracle that identifies the first incorrect step and the corresponding backtrack location. The authors note that ordinary instruction-following models may not localize reasoning errors reliably; replacing the oracle with a stronger model would introduce teacher error and calibration questions not tested here.

The privileged boundary is task-dependent. Countdown deliberately inserts optimal operations and arithmetic states into retained traces. This can teach useful recovery structure, but it can also transmit target templates or make memorization hard to distinguish from search skill. Code repair creates a clearer text boundary by replacing the real reference program before SFT, yet a reproduction still needs to inspect serialized messages, loss masks, paths, and test fixtures to ensure privileged tokens do not survive elsewhere.

Interaction feedback and selection feedback differ. Code turns expose selected public-test failures, whereas the official preparation pipeline scores candidates against all task ground-truth tests and keeps positive rows. This can suppress visible public-test failures while hiding why other candidates were rejected. Test coverage, harness errors, timeouts, nondeterminism, and sandbox differences create false positives or false negatives; passing all available tests still does not establish semantic correctness outside them.

Outcome checks do not certify process quality. Countdown legality and code execution verify outcomes under their parsers and tests. They do not measure whether a rationale is faithful, whether a search branch was necessary, whether an explanation is safe, or whether a program is robust. Binary filtering also removes failed traces that would be useful for audit or contrastive supervision. The paper does not publish acceptance rates, rejection reasons, duplicate rates, or trace-length distributions.

Split and contamination evidence is incomplete. The unseen-target Countdown split reduces direct target memorization but does not audit structural template reuse. CodeContests is explicitly near-distribution because the training mixture contains that source. The paper and checked repository do not disclose a decontamination procedure across SYNTHETIC-1, APPS, CodeContests, TACO, and CodeForces, nor exact source revisions and per-source counts.

Release reproducibility is partial. The code is Apache-2.0 and provides commands, but the checked repository has no tag or release, generated rollout buffers, checkpoints, record manifest, or frozen environment image. The repository's license does not automatically determine rights for upstream problems, reference programs, or generated derivatives. Direct training reuse is therefore blocked pending a frozen snapshot, lineage and overlap audit, and license verification; the recipe is usable as an implementation and audit reference.

Experimental scope is narrow. The evidence covers four-number Countdown and Python code self-repair with executable tests. Code gains are moderate, episode-level guidance does not identify fine-grained code subgoals, and code receives no PPO experiment. The main results have no error bars, total generation cost is undisclosed, and benchmark improvement must not be treated as proof that every selected trajectory is high-quality or broadly reusable.

获取特权最优解是核心假设。 Guided-ReST 需要最优 Countdown 路径或参考程序。Countdown 还假设存在 oracle，能够定位第一个错误步骤及其回退位置。作者指出，普通指令模型未必能可靠地定位推理错误；若改用更强模型充当 oracle，就会引入本文未验证的教师错误与校准问题。

特权边界随任务而异。 Countdown 会有意把最优运算和算术状态插入保留轨迹。这可能教授有用的恢复结构，也可能传递目标模板，使记忆与搜索能力难以区分。代码修复通过在 SFT 前替换真实参考程序，建立了更清晰的文本边界；但复现时仍需检查序列化消息、loss mask、路径和测试夹具，确认特权 token 没有从其他位置残留。

交互反馈与筛选反馈并不相同。 代码回合向模型展示选出的公开测试失败，官方整理流水线却用任务附带的全部 ground-truth tests 为候选打分，并只保留正分记录。这可能在消除可见公开测试失败的同时，隐藏其他候选被拒绝的原因。测试覆盖、harness 错误、timeout、非确定性和 sandbox 差异都可能产生假阳性或假阴性；通过全部可用测试仍不能证明程序在测试之外语义正确。

结果检查不能认证过程质量。 Countdown 合法性检查和代码执行只验证其 parser 与 tests 覆盖范围内的结果，不能判断 rationale 是否忠实、某个搜索分支是否必要、解释是否安全或程序是否稳健。二元筛选还会删除对审计或对比监督有价值的失败轨迹。论文没有发布接受率、拒绝原因、重复率或轨迹长度分布。

划分与污染证据不完整。 Countdown 的未见目标划分降低了直接目标记忆风险，却没有审计结构模板复用。CodeContests 因训练混合中含同源题而被明确视为近分布。论文与核验仓库均未披露 SYNTHETIC-1、APPS、CodeContests、TACO 和 CodeForces 之间的去污染流程，也未给出精确来源版本与各来源数量。

发布复现性仍为 partial。 代码以 Apache-2.0 发布并提供命令，但核验仓库没有 tag 或 release、生成 rollout buffer、checkpoint、record manifest 或冻结环境镜像。仓库许可证不会自动决定上游题目、参考程序和生成派生物的权利。直接训练复用因此仍被阻塞，需先完成冻结快照、谱系与重叠审计和许可证核验；当前更适合作为实现配方与审计参考。

实验范围较窄。 证据只覆盖四数字 Countdown 与带可执行测试的 Python 代码自修复。代码增益中等，episode-level guidance 无法定位细粒度代码子目标，代码任务也没有 PPO 实验。主结果没有 error bar，总生成成本未披露；基准提升不能被当作每条入选轨迹都高质量或可广泛复用的证明。

title: Usefulness
用途
html:
For the Data Construction and Open Release Recipes track, this work is a concrete pattern for distilling privileged guidance without exposing the same interface at deployment. It identifies the task source, policy author, oracle artifact, localized transformation, programmatic acceptance check, iteration schedule, optimizer, and evaluation budget for both node-level and episode-level search.

Recipe reconstruction. Reimplement the pipeline as separate stages: task and solution sourcing; unguided policy generation; failure localization; privileged continuation; construction-view to training-view transformation; programmatic scoring; positive-row filtering; iterative SFT; and optional Countdown PPO. Keeping these stages separate makes it possible to test whether gains come from guidance, a stronger verifier, more samples, or downstream optimization.

Minimum auditable Countdown record. Preserve task ID and split, input integers, target, source revision, original policy trace, selected child and parent node, injected subgoal index and operation, truncation offset, regenerated suffix, full legality verdict, generator checkpoint, sampling configuration, iteration, and rejection reason. Both pre-edit and post-edit traces are needed to measure how much oracle structure was inserted.

Minimum auditable code record. Preserve task source and revision, prompt, turn boundaries, every code attempt, public-test selection rule and feedback, all-tests score, success turn, reference-solution provenance, a privileged_generation_only flag, the exact dummy replacement transform, loss mask, execution-harness and sandbox version, sampling seed, and whether the row was retained. The pre-mask view contains privileged reference code and may require access and license controls; the train view alone cannot reconstruct the intervention.

Controlled studies. Compare behavior cloning, SoS, ReST, Guided-ReST, and Guided-ReST plus PPO at matched base model, unique task pool, number of attempts, verifier, token budget, and optimizer. Report accepted-record counts, pass@k curves, token-efficiency curves, and corpus statistics separately. Audit the difference between public-feedback stopping and all-tests filtering, and independently re-execute selected code on held-out tests unavailable to the generator.

Reuse decision. The implementation is suitable as a recipe and audit reference. The generated data are blocked pending verification for direct training reuse because no frozen trajectory snapshot, record manifest, rejected set, decontamination report, or consolidated upstream license was verified. Before reuse, pin the repository commit and author-hosted input revisions, freeze an environment image, hash prompts and tests, rerun duplicate and contamination checks across all named code sources, and publish accepted plus rejected record lineage.

对 Data Construction and Open Release Recipes 方向而言，这项工作提供了一个具体模式：利用特权引导完成蒸馏，但不让部署接口看到同样的信息。它在节点级与 episode-level 搜索中都说明了任务来源、策略作者、oracle 产物、局部变换、程序化接收检查、迭代日程、优化器和评测预算。

配方重建。 应把流水线拆成独立阶段：任务与解答来源、无引导策略生成、失败定位、特权续写、构造视图到训练视图的变换、程序化打分、正向记录筛选、迭代 SFT，以及可选 Countdown PPO。只有分开这些阶段，才能检验增益来自引导、更强 verifier、更多样本还是后续优化。

Countdown 最小可审计记录。 至少保留任务 ID 与 split、输入整数、目标数、来源版本、原始策略轨迹、被选子节点及其父节点、注入子目标索引与运算、截断位置、重新生成后缀、完整合法性判定、生成器 checkpoint、采样配置、迭代轮次和拒绝原因。改写前后轨迹都需保存，才能测量注入了多少 oracle 结构。

代码最小可审计记录。 至少保留任务来源与版本、prompt、轮次边界、每次代码尝试、公开测试选择规则与反馈、全测试分数、成功轮次、参考解 provenance、privileged_generation_only 标记、精确 dummy 替换变换、loss mask、执行 harness 与 sandbox 版本、采样 seed 和记录是否被保留。遮蔽前视图含特权参考代码，可能需要访问和许可证控制；只有训练视图无法重建这次介入。

受控研究。 应在相同基础模型、唯一任务池、尝试次数、verifier、token 预算和优化器下，对比 behavior cloning、SoS、ReST、Guided-ReST 与 Guided-ReST 加 PPO。接收记录数、pass@k 曲线、token 效率曲线和语料统计应分别报告。还应审计“公开反馈停止”与“全测试筛选”的差异，并在生成器不可见的留出测试上独立重执行入选代码。

复用判断。 官方实现适合作为配方与审计参考；生成数据在直接训练复用方面属于 blocked pending verification，因为未核验到冻结轨迹快照、record manifest、拒绝集合、去污染报告或统一上游许可证。复用前应固定仓库 commit 与作者托管输入版本，冻结环境镜像，对 prompt 和 tests 计算哈希，在所有具名代码来源之间重做重复与污染检查，并同时发布接收和拒绝记录的 lineage。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
• Read the method as three data views: privileged construction, edited or dummy-masked training, and unassisted inference. The available fields and leakage risks differ in each view.
  • Countdown subgoal augmentation changes the retained trace itself; audit both the pre-edit trace and the injected node, not only the final successful trajectory.
  • Code interaction uses public-test feedback, but the official preparation code filters SFT rows by a score computed from all task ground-truth tests. Interaction stopping and dataset acceptance are distinct contracts.
  • Keep Guided-ReST SFT separate from operation-level PPO. The code experiment has no PPO stage, and pass@k is reported as a proxy rather than direct RL evidence.
  • Read Paper Tables 1-3 and Figures 3, 5, and 6 first; then inspect the supplement prompt figures and repository masking/filtering code. Generated buffers, rejection statistics, decontamination, and upstream license compatibility remain unresolved.

• 阅读时应区分三种数据视图：特权构造视图、改写或 dummy 遮蔽后的训练视图、无辅助推理视图；三者可见字段与泄漏风险不同。
  • Countdown 子目标增强会直接改变保留轨迹；审计时应同时查看改写前轨迹和被注入节点，而不能只看最终成功轨迹。
  • 代码交互使用公开测试反馈，但官方整理代码根据任务全部 ground-truth tests 计算的分数筛选 SFT 记录；交互停止与数据接收是两个不同契约。
  • 比较时要把 Guided-ReST SFT 与 operation-level PPO 分开；代码实验没有 PPO 阶段，pass@k 只是代理指标而非直接 RL 证据。
  • 建议先读论文 Tables 1-3 和 Figures 3、5、6，再看补充材料中的 prompt 图与仓库遮蔽、筛选代码；生成 buffer、拒绝统计、去污染和上游许可证兼容性仍未解决。

value.html: Countdown questions use four input integers and targets from 10 to 100 under the Stream of Search setup; code self-repair uses 16,000 PrimeIntellect SYNTHETIC-1 problems drawn from APPS, CodeContests, and TACO with at least one reference solution.

Countdown records are language-form tree-search traces containing generation, exploration, verification, and backtracking operations. Code records are multi-turn messages containing full reasoning-and-code attempts plus execution feedback.
The current policy authors the search trace or multi-turn repair episode. Optimal Countdown paths and reference programs are privileged construction-time landmarks rather than inference-time inputs.

items: code attempt, public-test feedback, and revision instruction
dummy-masked training view for guided code feedback
sampling seed, iteration, and turn boundary in generated files

value.html: Iterative offline trajectory generation followed by SFT. Countdown uses a parser and arithmetic transition checker; code self-repair executes extracted Python in the repository's test harness and feeds a public-test subset back between turns.

Countdown receives binary reward from grade_search_path when a legal trace reaches the target. Code generation receives public-test feedback, while the released implementation scores the candidate against all ground-truth tests attached to the task and the data-preparation step retains only rows with score greater than zero.

Countdown succeeds when the trace legally reaches the target. A code interaction stops when the detected public tests pass or the four-turn limit is reached; acceptance into SFT additionally requires the programmatic all-tests score to be positive.
Llama-3.2-1B-Instruct for Countdown; Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct for code self-repair
Ground-truth Countdown solutions and reference programs provide training-only landmarks. No learned reward model or human preference judge supplies the acceptance signal.
current policy

Countdown samples one trace for each of 200,000 problems per iteration at temperature 1.0, top-p 1.0, and at most 4,096 response tokens. Code samples eight episodes for each of 16,000 problems, with at most four turns, temperature 1.0, top-p 1.0, and at most 16,384 response tokens. Each generate-and-SFT cycle is repeated three times.
1 per Countdown problem; 8 per code problem

Apply progressive subgoal or episode augmentation, then retain only successful rows. The official preparation scripts filter on score greater than zero; Countdown score checks legal target reachability, and code score requires passing the task's ground-truth execution tests.

Countdown evaluation varies the response budget up to 4,096 tokens. Code episodes allow up to four turns and 16,384 response tokens; total project-wide generation tokens and wall-clock cost are not disclosed.
Two-epoch SFT with AdamW is repeated for three Guided-ReST iterations. Countdown optionally continues with operation-level PPO using binary outcome reward; the code experiment does not run PPO.

Countdown tasks are generated under the Stream of Search recipe. Code training problems come through SYNTHETIC-1 from APPS, CodeContests, and TACO, but per-source counts and exact upstream revisions for the selected 16,000 problems are not disclosed.

Countdown target values from 10 to 100 are split 90 percent for training and 10 percent for unseen-target testing; seen-target and unseen-target evaluation each use 10,000 examples. CodeContests evaluation has 165 problems and is near-distribution; CodeForces evaluation has 408 more recent problems and is reported as out-of-distribution. A frozen generated-trajectory split and record manifest are not released.
unknown

items: Privileged Countdown subgoals remain in augmented traces and can transmit solution-template structure.
The code generator sees only selected public-test feedback, but final SFT selection uses all attached tests; weak or overlapping tests can admit shortcuts.
Binary outcome success does not establish that every textual reasoning or search operation is faithful, minimal, safe, or robust.
A policy can overfit public-test feedback, and code execution can be sensitive to harness, timeout, dependency, and sandbox versions.
Failed and rejected trajectories, acceptance rates, duplicate rates, and trace-length distributions are not published as a frozen release.
The official repository has no tag or GitHub release and does not publish trained checkpoints or generated rollout buffers.
Decontamination and overlap analysis across SYNTHETIC-1, APPS, CodeContests, TACO, and CodeForces are not disclosed.

value.html: The official implementation is Apache-2.0. Licenses and compatible redistribution terms for the upstream Countdown and SYNTHETIC-1-derived task records, reference programs, and any generated trajectories require separate verification.

Answer-keyed task and optimal artifact -> current-policy search or repair episode -> localized privileged guidance -> programmatic outcome scoring -> successful-record filtering -> iterative SFT -> optional Countdown PPO.
